style: 既存の彩色人物画に合わせた腰までの透過画像。肖像・立ち絵で同じ画像を共用。性別・外見・年代は今回の美術設定で、原文の既定情報ではない。

files.prompt_en: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an isolated transparent dialogue character cutout for a Japanese dungeon RPG, delivered as a PNG with genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the person. Single adult character, centered waist-up composition, complete hair silhouette and both hands visible, lower edge below the belt, generous empty transparent margins at both sides and above. Vertical portrait canvas, 1024 by 1536 pixels. Detailed painted game illustration with tactile linen and worn leather, clean readable facial features, muted earth colors, soft warm light from upper left, eye-level three-quarter view. The whole surrounding area is fully empty transparency, including the space beside the shoulders and head. Plain unlettered clothing surfaces. Subject: Ose, an independent surveyor, an adult man in his early fifties with a medium build, warm olive skin, a long angular face, deep-set dark grey eyes, thick salt-and-pepper hair neatly swept back from a high forehead and a short tidy salt-and-pepper moustache. His expression is guarded and thoughtful, brows slightly drawn together, listening carefully while preserving his professional dignity. He wears a plain muted wine-red wool field jacket with a simple upright collar over a pale sand linen shirt, worn dark brown leather shoulder reinforcements and a narrow dark belt. The jacket is practical, fitted and slightly weathered. Both empty hands are completely visible at belt level, one hand resting lightly around the other wrist. His posture is upright and restrained. His long greying head shape, moustache and wine-red jacket make his silhouette distinct.
files.prompt_ja: 用途：日本語ダンジョンRPGの透過会話人物画。人物以外の全域に透明なアルファを持つPNG。成人1人を中央に配置し、髪の輪郭と両手が入り、帯の下で自然に終わる腰までの構図。左右と頭上に十分な透過余白を取る。1024×1536の縦画面。麻と使い込まれた革の質感を備えた緻密な彩色ゲーム人物画。顔の特徴が読み取りやすく、落ち着いた土色、左上からの柔らかい暖色光、目の高さからの斜め正面。肩や頭の周囲も完全な透過。衣服は文字のない無地。人物はオセ、独立した測量師。50代前半の成人男性。中肉で温かみのあるオリーブ色の肌、面長で角張った顔、奥まった濃い灰色の目。白髪交じりの豊かな髪を広い額から後ろへ整え、短く手入れした白髪交じりの口ひげを蓄える。眉を少し寄せ、用心深く思案し、職業人としての尊厳を保ちながら注意深く話を聞く表情。簡素な立ち襟のくすんだ葡萄酒色のウールの野外用上着と、薄い砂色の麻シャツ。肩に使い込まれた濃茶色の革の補強、細い濃色のベルト。上着は実用的で身体に合い、少し風雨にさらされた質感。空の両手全体を帯の高さに見せ、片手をもう一方の手首へ軽く添える。背筋は伸ばし、控えめな姿勢。面長の白髪交じりの頭部、口ひげ、葡萄酒色の上着で輪郭を明確にする。
